hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | grep -qE 'skills/academic-figure/assets/|examples/layouts/layouts.py|examples/chart-types/|examples/papers/' && (cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && nohup sh -c "uv run --no-project -p 3.12 --with 'matplotlib>=3.10' --with numpy --with pyyaml --with scipy python examples/layouts/layouts.py; uv run --no-project -p 3.12 --with 'matplotlib>=3.10' --with numpy --with pyyaml --with scipy python examples/build_charts.py; uv run --no-project -p 3.12 --with 'matplotlib>=3.10' --with numpy --with pyyaml --with scipy --with pymupdf python examples/papers/build.py" > examples/layouts/last-run.log 2>&1 &) ; exit 0
